deploy-bot: publishbot: image publish failed for service/worker:v1.27.4 -> digest sha256:abc123. Attestation mismatch between primary ECR and mirror GCR, skipping promote. logs: https://internal.ci/publish/1726401234
joan: we were in the final canary window — is this a rollback or pin situation?
anya: looking at logs, cosign verification passed on ECR but the mirror returned 'attestation timestamp < manifest.created_at' — looks like the mirror agent rewrote manifest annotations. @ben can you check mirror side?
rob: if the mirror mutated manifest timestamps, provenance guard will reject. safest immediate action is pin canary back to last-good digest and hold the promote. then retag+re-attest.
ben: confirmed mirror agent rewraps the manifest list for multi-arch and rewrites annotations, which resets annotation timestamps to upload time. this can cause timestamp ordering issues with our provenance guard. I'll investigate config.
sre-oncall: given this is a release window, abort canary promotion and roll back to pinned digest. set release flag to HOLD and notify QA. :warning:
joan: agreed. rob, can you open the rollback and update release notes to mention a retag?
rob: on it. rolling back canary to sha256:prev111. running deploybot rollback now:
```
deploybot rollback service/worker --to-digest sha256:prev111 --reason "mirror attestation mismatch"
```
anya: filed MIRROR-2381 to track the mirror rewrap behavior. @ben please coordinate retag+cosign reattest after mirror fix.
ben: plan -> 1) disable mirror's manifest rewrite temporarily; 2) re-push signed manifest from primary; 3) verify cosign attestation; 4) re-run publish job. ETA ~45m.
deploy-bot: rollback started by @rob. Rollback complete on canary (pods restarted) — image pinned sha256:prev111. No errors.
joan: :thumbsup: QA notify? @sre-oncall please create incident and update release timeline.
sre-oncall: creating short incident INC-4521, will update release calendar and message #product. tentative next release window in ~2h after mirror fix.
rob: adding short note to release notes: 'Publish delayed due to mirror attestation mismatch; retagging planned; no user-facing impact.'
anya: follow-up: add an early check to publishbot to compare attestation timestamp <= manifest.created_at and fail early if ordering looks wrong. filing ENG-verify ticket.
ben: sync completed locally, re-pushing signed manifest now — will ping here once publish job passes.
deploy-bot: publish job succeeded for service/worker:v1.27.4 -> sha256:abc123 after mirror fix. Canary can resume once QA green. logs: https://internal.ci/publish/1726402000
joan: thanks all. holding final promote until QA thumbs up. closing thread."
